name: Phi Bloom
author: Motif
description: Golden-angle botanical sculpture: layered translucent blades, a readable logarithmic spiral, ivory and champagne against jade-black depth. Nine seamless infinite loops.

styles.name: Phi Bloom Hero
styles.blurb: The flagship: 144 ivory blades on a golden-angle lattice, a champagne log-spiral thread and a copper-lit foreground.

petals.label: Petal count
petals.hint: Number of petals in each golden-angle spiral. Spatial count, not a motion rate.

pitch.label: Spiral pitch
pitch.hint: Growth rate b of the glowing logarithmic scaffold r = r0·e^(b·a). Separate from the petal lattice.

bladeLen.label: Blade length
bladeLen.hint: Half length of a mid-field blade in scene units (short side = 1).

taper.label: Blade taper
taper.hint: How sharply each blade narrows toward its tip.

depth.label: Depth spacing
depth.hint: Separation of the far, middle and foreground strata. Drives parallax and defocus.

translucency.label: Translucency
translucency.hint: Light transmitted through thin edges and tips.

rim.label: Rim intensity
rim.hint: Champagne rim light on blade edges.

caustic.label: Copper caustics
caustic.hint: Thin copper light threads that follow the blade form.

core.label: Core glow
core.hint: Seed light at the spiral centre. Keep low so the geometry stays visible.

turns.label: Turns per loop
turns.hint: Complete rotations of the whole field per loop (whole numbers only).

unfold.label: Unfold
unfold.hint: A radial unfold wave that returns through a fold. 0 holds the blooms open.

flow.label: Flow steps per loop
flow.hint: Whole lattice indices the petals travel along the spiral each loop. 0 = rotation only.

orbit.label: Camera orbit
orbit.hint: Closed camera orbit amplitude. Drives parallax between the strata.

keyAngle.label: Key direction
keyAngle.hint: Direction of the key light in the picture plane, degrees.

exposure.label: Exposure
exposure.hint: Linear exposure before the single tone map.

bloom.label: Bloom
bloom.hint: Glow added around emissive light. 0 shows the bare geometry.

bloomRadius.label: Bloom radius
bloomRadius.hint: Width of the glow relative to the frame.

lensCA.label: Edge fringe
lensCA.hint: Spectral fringing toward the frame edge.

vignette.label: Vignette
vignette.hint: Darkens the frame edge; never touches the focal area.

quality.label: Quality
quality.hint: Sample counts only. Composition, phase and exposure stay the same.
